impact_big.note: has a ~1.3 s swell before the hit: align hit, not file start

impact_trailer.use: the single biggest reveal of a video (use once)

sub_knock.use: numbers/stats landing, list beats (felt, not heard)

riser.use: build into a reveal; ends at the hit

typing_run.use: text typing on screen letter by letter (cut any length from it)

key_press.use: last letter / Enter on typed text

scribble.use: highlighter sweep / quick writing (substitute for highlighter)

shutter.use: photo appears / hard cut to a photo

boom_distant.use: deep distant boom under dramatic lines (keep low)

riser_synth.use: long build into a reveal (tonal; use sparingly, low)

woosh_air.use: quick soft transition / element flying in

stamp.note: single stamp cut from 4; preview-quality MP3

polaroid.source: Freesound 444682 "taking a Polaroid photo" by larspriebe

coin_prize.use: gold coin / ring landing (use first 0.35 s only; long prize-ring tail)

space_drone.use: deep space bed under star / space scenes (loop, low)

meteor_fall.use: meteor / fireball streak; peak at 2.54 s = impact

lava_flow.source: Mixkit volcano eruption with lava flow 2443

sparkle_soft.use: stardust / particles forming (keep very low; can feel childish)

metal_transform.use: mechanical clunk: balance scale, machines, parts locking

water_bubbles.use: liquid bubbling / dissolving in acid (closest real match to acid fizz)

jar_set_down.use: glass jar placed on a shelf/table

coin_flutter.use: single metallic clink: medal, coin landing

coin_win.use: AVOID mostly: bright game-like chime; only very low under a price reveal

footsteps_soft_indoor.note: soft walking loop, not running: speed up ~1.3x and trim 1.5-2 s
